passive.name: Friend of the Forest
passive.desc: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.

spells.name: Rootcaller
spells.desc: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.

spells.name: Brushmaker
spells.desc: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.

spells.name: Triggerseed
spells.desc: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.

spells.name: Daisy!
spells.desc: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.
